Ana (CSM): Heads-up — Cascade Labs is onboarding 3 new internal teams next month (search, docs, analytics). They expect steady traffic + a 2x burst during their partner demo week. Asking for capacity and a short enablement plan.
Matt (AE): Do they want an autoscale policy tweak or a reserved capacity bump? any PO timeline? cc @Sophia (Enablement).
Sophia (Enablement): I can run two 45min enablement sessions (devs + product). Need canonical prompt sets, examples of tool-calls, and any custom connectors. Also want to capture quality baselines for summarization and embeddings.
Ana (CSM): Also flagged: embeddings token usage is ~30% higher than their pilot. They suspect longer contexts + repeated vectorization of doc chunks. Asked about quantization options to cut cost.
DevOps Bot: Deploy/billing-bot: Reserved capacity increase request submitted -> ticket `CL-4132` (state: queued). ETA for approval: 48h.
Matt (AE): Started procurement thread with their finance team. PO estimate: ~2 weeks if go-ahead today. Renewal note: their contract renewal date is 2026-06-01; if cost spikes persist they may push back on expansion spend.
Sophia (Enablement): I'll prepare a runbook and a short FAQ. Sharing link once ready: https://redwood.in/enable/cascade (draft). Will collect 5 representative prompts from them to include in the eval.
Ravi (ML): We can run a quick quantization and perf eval. Request: provide model name, sample embedding workload, and a 1-hour window for a test run. I'll try Q4 and Q5 pipelines and measure recall drift.
Ana (CSM): Action items: 1) ticket CL-4132 for reserve bump (DevOps) 2) Sophia to run enablement sessions week of 3/22 3) Ravi to deliver perf/quality eval by 3/26. I'll update the account health dashboard and tag renewal-warning if PO slips.
Matt (AE): Noted. I'll nudge finance and loop back here. :thumbsup:
Sophia (Enablement): Will capture feedback form during sessions and add to the shared Google doc. If embedding drift is real, we'll include mitigation notes (cache+preprocessing). :memo:
Ana (CSM): Thanks — please ping here with any blockers. I'll keep exec sponsor in the loop.
